items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: He had Benny Golson, Thad Jones, let’s see who else, I can’t really remember.

ctx.x: Yeah I recorded with him. I just worked with him not long ago. He has a great ... there is a nice album I recorded with Joe.

He had Benny Golson, Thad Jones, let’s see who else, I can’t really remember. Did he have Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis? I can’t remember all the guys that was on the date but it was great. Very nice. I’ve done several albums with him.
